[[Streets of Tarkov]] |chapter = |enemies =[[Scavs]], [[Killa]], [[Tagilla]] |players =11-15 |difficulty = |duration =40 minutes |notable loot = }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Map of Tarkov|location]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. It is the fifth map that was added to the game. ==Description== The South Interchange is a key transport location for the city. This strategic area connects the port and harbor with the industrial outskirts of Tarkov. Located in the center of the interchange is a huge ULTRA shopping mall which was used as the main base of operation for the EMERCOM evacuation. ==Features== * Stationary weapons in the form of [[NSV Utyos 12.7x108 heavy machine gun]]s. * Be aware of [[Map of Tarkov#Border Snipers|Border Snipers]] and [[Map of Tarkov#Minefields|Minefields]]! * A fully linked illumination grid, able to be switched on at the power station.
